scope: Read-only single gzip traversal of saved actual ROI motion; no new trial/physics/source/Git operation.

traceManifest.timeOrigin: Physics actual time; phase0. Sequence preserves observed solver order; motion timeStart/timeEnd is separate from gameTime. No predicted samples.

plane.rationale: rotor maxR9.506445+ball1.8 about original windmill centre64; geometric upper-entry proxy, not contact guarantee

definitions.positionTime: linear interpolation only within one actual pre-collider integration segment
definitions.velocity: post-gravity velocity used by actual integration; endpoint-linear velocity also retained separately
definitions.first: first saved motion with before.y<460<=after.y, vy trajectory descending and front at both endpoints
definitions.roi: Only motion intersecting x20..100,y390..500 was saved; absent gate is unobserved, not certified non-arrival
definitions.contacts: Actual repeated successful pin37..63 reflection, latest strictly before gate time; wall/pair calls not saved here and intervening order remains unknown
definitions.planeComparison: gate is above current uppermost envelope but rotated vane contact depends on angle and subsequent path
